comparisons.reason: Both are any-comment binary features over OC_comments, but the eligibility rules differ. Feature 0 counts any specific concrete example or real-world instance, including a study or a specific situation, and requires no checkability. Feature 1 requires a specific case with checkable or observable particulars ("locally verifiable"), a term it leaves undefined. It also requires the comment to offer the example in its own voice and explicitly excludes quoted OP text. Feature 1 is therefore narrower, and its undefined verifiability boundary is a material unresolved rule. Feature 0 has no quote or attribution exclusion.
